note: User-visible strings added by ADR new-primitives-polyhedra-text (phase 2: Torus, Triangular prism, Advanced shapes, Letters, numbers & symbols). dom-baseline.mjs accepts exactly these additions to the aab9865 string baseline; anything else new, or any removal, still fails. ADR-0001 W0 (3.0 v3-foundation): "tristancad.autosave.v3" is the internal localStorage key of the dual-key autosave (§2.2, Q14), not UI text. W0 mode bar and dock (ADR-0001 §2.3, round-2 ruling 1): "Rotate" and "Mirror" are the reserved, hidden mode-bar buttons; "Export" is the renamed dock button. "Export STL" leaves the string table at the W0 re-baseline (strings-baseline.json --update after Sean's approval). ADR-0001 F1a (keyboard-shortcuts): the help-sheet Keyboard shortcuts rows and the desktop pill text are the Sean-approved help text (2026-10-17 ~16:10 CT batch; the table grows with the features, round-2 ruling 2, so F1a ships only the rows of commands that exist, and "F Round" is the approved "F Round ▾ (press F again for Chamfer)" row before F6). The old pill string leaves the table at the W0 re-baseline, like "Export STL". Not UI text: "Delete", "Backspace", "Home", "Dead" and "Unidentified" are KeyboardEvent.key names in commands.mjs ("Delete" and "Duplicate" are also registry labels, the existing Edit-sheet button labels); "mode:…" and "view:…" are registry command ids. ADR-0001 F1c (inch-units): "tristancad.units" is the internal localStorage key of the display-unit preference (§2.4 F1c), not UI text.
